design: 13 variants in five mechanism families; three old targets and ten authored after core freeze
independence: Author-constructed assessment following the case-selection core freeze

Historical stale-response branch clears independent approval and returns false

excluded.reason: The card adapter declares one purpose; purpose isolation is assessed in the separate native LangGraph experiment
Crash recovery requires a separate file-backed experiment; this suite executes serial in-memory transitions

field_change_boundary: Answer/question edits use the public text-edit API. Evidence/source replacement uses that invalidation plus a named synthetic storage change; all generators and controls receive the same mapping.
inclusion_rule: Executable and independently witnessed contract difference. A generator miss cannot exclude a variant. Field omissions are grouped in one family.
